quality_guards: Foundry risk depends on metal, furnace, process, silica content, fume extraction, PPE, maintenance, competence and exposure duration.
Lead risk depends on chemical form, task, airborne and ingestion pathways, exposure duration, hygiene, controls and worker susceptibility.
Metalworking-fluid risk depends on formulation, mist generation, bacterial load, enclosure, extraction, skin contact, maintenance and exposure duration.
Biological-agent risk depends on agent, hazard group, route, dose, task, containment, worker susceptibility and emergency readiness.
Listeriosis risk depends on food type, contamination level, storage, dose, host vulnerability, symptoms and exposure timing.
Campylobacter risk depends on food source, cooking, cross-contamination, water, animal contact, hygiene, host factors and season.
Hepatitis A risk depends on exposure route, sanitation, food, travel, contact setting, immunity, timing and host factors.
Blind-cord risk depends on loop geometry, cord accessibility, installation, furniture position, child age, supervision and device condition.
Turbulence injury risk depends on intensity, warning time, passenger movement, restraint use, cabin service, aircraft phase and crew response.
Rail fatigue risk depends on roster, shift timing, overtime, travel, workload, sleep opportunity, individual factors, reporting and safety culture.
